rebase_metadata.weight_vector_source_rationale: Equal-weight fallback (0.125 x 8) replaced with default WeightConfig values per tuner root-cause analysis (memory key v14_r1_gate1_root_cause). The equal-weight fallback depressed the trading composite by ~2.1% by over-weighting trading_annualized_volatility (0.125 vs default 0.0532, weakest honest-miner metric at ~0.70 normalized) and under-weighting trading_annualized_return and trading_consistency (0.125 vs default 0.2128, strongest honest-miner metrics at ~0.90 normalized). Default WeightConfig values are the correct weights for honest-miner optimization. Canonical keys match PARAM_NAMES.
